title: StrongARM comparator
description: A dynamic StrongARM latch budgeted through the integration phase, where all the analog action lives. One input device is bound at the integration-phase current so the sheet ends in silicon; the integration time follows from charging the output node $C_{int}$ to $\Delta V_{int}$, the input-referred noise is the $kT/C$-style thermal floor of that integration, the offset is the Pelgrom spread of the input pair, and the decision time adds a regeneration time constant $\tau_{reg} = C_{int}/g_{m,latch}$. Every closed form here is estimate-grade: dynamic comparators are sim-verified for offset, noise, and metastability, and this sheet only budgets. $\gamma$ is the constant thermal-noise factor (the table's $\gamma$ column refines it when present).

params.name: dV_int
params.note: voltage built on C_int during integration before regeneration takes over

params.name: I_int
params.note: input-device current during the integration phase

params.name: vds_in
params.note: input-device drain bias during integration, signed to the table axis

params.name: gm_latch_est
params.note: regeneration transconductance estimate of the cross-coupled latch; sim refines it

params.name: V_logic
params.note: logic level the regeneration must reach for a valid decision

params.name: T_clk_half
params.note: half the clock period: the time budget for integration plus regeneration

rows.name: t_int
rows.note: integration time to build dV_int on C_int; estimate

rows.name: sigma_n
rows.note: input-referred thermal noise of the integration phase, kT/C-style; estimate, gamma is the model factor

rows.name: vos
rows.note: input-pair Pelgrom offset at the sized geometry

rows.name: tau_reg
rows.note: regeneration time constant of the cross-coupled latch; estimate

rows.name: t_decide
rows.note: integration plus exponential regeneration from dV_int to the logic level; estimate

rules.note: gm/ID cannot exceed the weak-inversion ceiling of the data
integration-phase noise under budget; estimate-grade, sim signs off
integration plus regeneration must resolve within the half clock; estimate, metastability is sim-owned
